display_name: The Veil of the Last Mirage

clergy.vestments: indigo veils, mirrored pendants, and white sand-marking gloves
clergy.holy_symbol: silver eye behind a rippling veil

cosmology.opposing_view_detail: Lawful powers are condemned as prison lamps that promise safety only to blind souls willing to live inside a cage of light.
cosmology.notes: See §3.3 Alignment Cosmology Rules for the hard constraints governing this field.

pantheon.domains_summary: Ishra rules revelation, hidden truth, moonlit guidance, and freedom purchased through peril.

flavor_text.one_line: A harsh desert monotheism that reveres revelation only when it shatters false certainty.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Veil of the Last Mirage holds that all fixed systems of law, wealth, and empire are mirages cast by lesser minds to avoid the terror of truth. Ishra reveals herself only in paradox, danger, thirst, and disciplined vision. Her priestesses guide caravans, interpret dreams, and rule shrine-cities, insisting that souls are refined by uncertainty rather than comfort.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: Ishra breathed on the empty waste, and every false certainty became shimmering sand until only revelation remained.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Seek truth in hardship, give water before command, follow living revelation over dead custom, and destroy any order that claims holiness through control alone.
